move: card tilts on a figure-eight, rainbow foil slides and hue-cycles, sheen wipes
how: A single portrait card sits in 3D perspective over a blurred conic-gradient halo. Every frame the card rotates rotateY sin(p)*22deg and rotateX cos(p)*10-2deg for one figure-eight per loop; an oversized rainbow gradient foil layer (mix-blend screen) translates opposite the tilt (-ry*6px, rx*8px) with a slight rotate and its hue-rotate filter runs 0 to 360deg across the loop, over a diagonal grating and an SVG feTurbulence grain. A hard white sheen band wipes across the card once per loop (translateX -60% to 60%). The halo spins a full turn and pulses scale +/-8% twice per loop. Every parameter is periodic in the loop so the last frame equals the first.
adapt: Replace the card title, chip, subtitle, logo and the foil gradient stops; tilt amplitudes (22/10deg) and foil travel factors are tunable. Keep the one-cycle-per-loop periodicity so it loops.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the halo, card (foil, grate, sheen, noise, ink) and caption inside el, including the inline SVG filter with a unique id. animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline holding one proxy tween ({t:0}->{t:D}, ease none) whose onUpdate writes the card, foil, sheen and halo transforms and filter, replacing the fx.register seek loop; gsap is loaded but only fx.register is used.
caveats: animates filter hue-rotate on a large foil layer plus a feTurbulence grain and blur(28px) halo every frame, render-heavy
no GSAP timeline in source; motion is a seek function writing inline styles
